nodes.summary: For every finite set $X$ and every hereditary family $F$ of subsets of $X$ (one containing every subset of each of its members) that contains a nonempty set, there is a point $x \in X$ such that every intersecting subfamily $G \subseteq F$ (one in which any two distinct members meet) has at most as many members as the star $\{A \in F : x \in A\}$.
nodes.title: Chvátal's conjecture holds

nodes.summary: The statement that for every finite set $X$ and every hereditary family $F$ of subsets of $X$ that contains a nonempty set, there is a point $x \in X$ such that every intersecting subfamily $G \subseteq F$ has at most as many members as the star $\{A \in F : x \in A\}$ of $x$. Here $F$ is hereditary when it contains every subset of each of its members, and $G$ is intersecting when any two distinct members of $G$…
nodes.title: Chvátal's conjecture

nodes.summary: A finite family $F$ of finite subsets of $\alpha$ is hereditary (an independence system) when it contains every subset of each of its members: if $A \in F$ and $B \subseteq A$, then $B \in F$.
nodes.title: Hereditary families

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
